newsitem.title: USA: Conn Health & Education Auth AAA/A1-plus - S&P.
newsitem.headline: Conn Health & Education Auth AAA/A1-plus - S&P.

text.p: NEW YORK, March 25 - Standard & Poor's Corp on Tuesday said it assigned its triple-A/A-1-plus rating to Connecticut Health and Education Facilities Authority's (CHEFA) $135.87 million revenue bonds series S due July 1, 2028, issued for Yale University.
In addition, ratings on the following, all issued for Yale, have been affirmed:
--CHEFA's $118.98 million bonds series B, C, K, Q and R at triple-A.
--CHEFA's $8.10 million bonds series D at triple-A.
--CHEFA's $96.30 million bonds series L-P at triple-A/A1-plus.
